skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand advanced theoretical and practical issues in labor economics.
Apply economic models and theories to explain labor market outcomes.
Compare and contrast labor market characteristics across geographic regions, industries, and ownership types.
Analyze and explain the impact of economic, social, demographic, environmental, and policy factors on labor market variables.
Construct and propose models to analyze and forecast labor market variables such as employment, wages, and inequality.
Use statistical tools to analyze and forecast labor market variables.
Apply research methods to analyze and forecast labor market issues.
Demonstrate initiative in learning, research, and group work.
Propose and implement solutions to labor market issues.
